name: Coffee
hook: The world's morning drug: caffeine, espresso, mocha and the Colombian grower on the label.

facts.label: caffeine
facts.statement: Caffeine is coffee's stimulant, isolated in the 1820s by Friedlieb Runge after Goethe asked what was in coffee; the Swiss Water process removes it.

facts.label: Java
facts.statement: Coffee was first grown outside Arabia on the Indonesian island of Java, whose name became slang for coffee.

facts.label: mocha
facts.statement: Mocha is named for the Yemeni Red Sea port of Al Mukha, and also means a chocolatey coffee flavor.

facts.label: espresso
facts.statement: Espresso is the strong coffee brewed in under 30 seconds; an Americano is espresso diluted with hot water.

facts.label: chicory
facts.statement: Chicory is the roasted root mixed with coffee, a staple in New Orleans, where it is also a salad green.

facts.label: Juan Valdez
facts.statement: Juan Valdez is the fictional Colombian coffee grower in ads for the Colombian Coffee Growers Federation, accompanied by his mule Conchita.

facts.label: Starbucks
facts.statement: Starbucks is the Seattle coffee chain named for the first mate in Moby-Dick.
